name: The Drowned Rat
description: A dockside dive dug into the bank halfway down the river stairs: one long, low, smoky room under a ceiling hung with eel traps and old oars, a scullery at the back, and a single door onto the stairs.

areas.name: the river stairs outside
areas.description: Wet green steps down to the river, the bunting on the quay above, the river slapping at the bottom.

areas.name: the doorway
areas.description: Three steps down from the landing; the rules board on the wall.

areas.name: the bar
areas.description: The upturned hull of a skiff, and Nan's shelf behind it.

areas.name: the floor
areas.description: Tables, benches, and a great many big men with a great many bandages.

areas.name: the fireside corner
areas.description: The blue driftwood fire, the champion's chair, Dilly's card table and, back to the wall, the biggest man in the room.

areas.name: the scullery
areas.description: Pots, steam and eel stew, and the slop hatch over the river.

things.name: the door
things.description: Low, heavy and rehung twenty years ago at the watch's expense (allegedly).

things.name: the rules board
things.description: THE DROWNED RAT. RULES OF THE HOUSE. 1. No credit. 2. No blades out. 3. No fighting indoors. 4. No watch on duty. 5. No singing before the ninth bell. 6. What's said in the Rat stays in the Rat. 7. Gossip sold by the measure. By order, N. Quill. Enforced by Manners.

things.name: the skiff-hull bar
things.description: An upturned skiff for a counter, tarred and much scarred.

things.name: Manners
things.description: Nan's blackthorn cudgel, polished by use, on two nails behind the bar.

things.name: the pewter measures
things.description: A gill, a half, a pint, a quart, on hooks: for beer and gossip alike.

things.name: the jar of gin with the drowned rat in it
things.description: The original drowned rat, floating in gin, older than Nan's tenure.

things.name: the jar marked FOREIGN
things.description: Under the bar: new silver pennies stamped with a heron.

things.name: the eel traps and old oars
things.description: Hung from the low ceiling beams; tarred, dry and very old.

things.name: the regulars
things.description: Porters, lightermen and bargees paid off early for the procession, most of them big and bandaged somewhere.

things.name: the blue driftwood fire
things.description: Driftwood burning blue with salt in a stone hearth.

things.name: the champion's chair
things.description: The Rat's only armchair, kept for the arm-wrestling champion of the river stairs. Hobb's, for eleven years.

things.name: the card table by the fire
a pack of cards and a pile of winnings
things.description: A pack worn soft as cloth, and a pile of coppers and heron pennies.

things.name: the slop hatch
things.description: Opens straight onto the river: just big enough for Cob, and the river under it is fast and cold.

nan-quill.note: behind the bar, within reach of Manners

arlo.note: elbow on the table by the door

hobb.note: back to the wall at the corner table, right hand out of sight under it

cob.note: keeping out of sight in the scullery
